verdicts.reason: A: the beige brush-stroke panel has come loose from the title. It floats in the upper half as a blank shape with stray dark artifact marks, the 'Weekly SPA items review' subtitle is almost as big as 'Spa Utopia', the bottom ~110px is empty, and the product photo is cropped down to unreadable fragments with none of the bottles left. B has almost the same layout and the same faults (oversized subtitle, empty bottom, lost products, jagged brush edge), but its brush panel reaches further down toward the title, so a little more of the original's 'title on a brush stroke' look survives.
